title: Door closing effort and charge door operation
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on charge door opening and closing problems, heavier-than-expected door closing effort, and comments about the absence or desirability of soft-close doors.

positive.summary: Positive remarks highlight convenient touch-based opening and closing features, though examples are limited.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on charging doors that fail to open or stay closed and cabin doors that require extra force or full closure to function properly.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews combine appreciation for premium door-related features with disappointment that soft-close doors are missing on the current vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention opening and closing doors or the lack of soft-close doors without enough context to tell whether the customer viewed this positively or negatively.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts concern charge-door operation, but some refer to main cabin door latching or feature availability, so the topic mixes related but distinct door subjects.
A large share of reviews in this topic are undetermined, which limits confidence about the overall sentiment mix from the examples alone.
Positive examples are sparse, so the range of favorable door-related experiences is not well represented in the sampled fragments.
